Y-Refi last year faced $750,000 in state sanctions in a settlement of action. of accusations of deceptive marketing and investment materials aimed at private funders who bankroll its refinancing of distressed and defaulted college loans, the company did not admit or deny the accusations. Watchdogs are sounding the alarm that its sponsorship deal with Turning Point has turned the late Charlie Kirk's nonprofit into a platform for what they say are potentially misleading financial deals.
